typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 up to 3.75rem (60px) on desktop. Keep contrast tight. Avoid large gaps in text hierarchy.

colors.rules: Landing Page: Dark theme hero (SD_INK) transitioning to warm Light page (FAFAF6). Dashboard: Unified light theme for clarity. Use Gold (#FFC61A) strictly for primary CTA.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky elements. Light: bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/40. Dark: bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #ECE9E1 on light cards to define boundaries clearly on the warm background.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (borderRadius: 9999px). Primary: Gold bg, Black text. Secondary: Outline with light/dark border based on theme.
components.cards: MUI Paper with borderRadius: 16px. Flat with 1px border. Drop shadow only on hover.
components.inputs: MUI TextField customized: 12px borderRadius, solid bg (white/dark2), 1px border. Focus state must use Gold ring.
components.chips: Status indicators: Success (#12B76A/10 bg, #12B76A text), Warning (#FF9F0A/10 bg, #FF9F0A text), Pending (Gold/10 bg, GoldDeep text).
components.icons: Use @iconify/react with Material Design Icons (mdi). Size 20-24px standard.

landing_page.hero: Split screen (grid lg:grid-cols-2). Left: Create Deal Form inside a glass/dark card. Right: 3D WebGL scene.
landing_page.how_it_works: 3-step horizontal strip below hero. Minimalist icons and brief text.
landing_page.fee_line: Compact banner. Text: '5% escrow fee · min $10 · deals from $30'.
landing_page.faq: Collapsed accordion list, clean borders, minimal padding.

dashboard_home.container: Max-width: xl, padding: 24px to 48px depending on breakpoint.
dashboard_home.balance_strip: Top row: 3 identical width cards. Available (with top-up/cash-out CTA), In Escrow, Paid out.
dashboard_home.active_deals: Horizontal scroll or bento grid. Each card shows: Role, Counterparty, Amount, Deadline, and a 5-step progress tracker.
dashboard_home.activity_feed: Flex rows instead of traditional table. Grouped by Month. Columns: Icon, Title/Deal Ref, Amount, Fee, Running Balance. Includes filters.
dashboard_home.documents: Month-grouped compact list with status chips and a PDF download button per row.

framer_motion.feed: Staggered entrance for Activity Feed rows.

3d_scene.description: Escrow flow visualization: Buyer node (left), SafeDeal Vault (center), Seller node (right). Golden USDT tokens animate flowing into the vault, pausing (locked state), then flowing to the seller.
3d_scene.fallback: Static premium 3D render image or a CSS-based glowing node diagram for devices with reduced motion.

accessibility.contrast: Text on Gold (#FFC61A) must be #0A0A0B to meet WCAG AA.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap 3D canvas and Framer animations in prefers-reduced-motion checks.
accessibility.aria: All icon buttons must have aria-labels.

implementation: 1. Render Canvas in right column of Hero.
3. Build 3 nodes: Buyer, Vault (shield/lock motif), Seller.
4. Animate spheres (coins) using useFrame along a Bezier curve path.
5. Implement a static fallback component for unsupported/mobile devices.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use MUI v5 (sx props) for styling components to match the Dynopay/SafeDeal codebase. Tailwind classes are only allowed if already prevalent for layout, but default to MUI.
Implement the single-screen landing hero. The left side must be the fully functional 'Create Deal' form that pushes state to /deals/new.
Merge /deals and /wallet into a unified Dashboard home view.
Replace the ever-growing statement table with a modern Activity Feed using flexbox rows, grouped by month.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='deal-create-btn').
Do not use generic centered text for forms and feeds. Keep them left-aligned.
Maintain the SafeDeal color tokens precisely (SD_GOLD, SD_INK).
Include empty states with CTAs for the Activity Feed and Active Deals.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
